listings.fi_reason: insufficient — audiology needs a license; official pages name Au.D. / hearing aid specialists but do not say licensed or insured and print no DPOR number
listings.christ_evidence: no on-site Christ/Scripture/CBMC/Simventions language; Army Veteran noted on bio only
official_quotes: Caring for our community’s hearing since 2011
We didn’t start our business to become hearing aid salespeople. We’re hearing aid specialists.
With over 26 years of experience in audiology, Dr. Paul Kuster is a trusted expert in hearing healthcare and the founder of Ascent Audiology & Hearing in Fredericksburg, Virginia.

Dr. Kuster earned his Bachelor of Science in Speech Pathology and Audiology from Stockton State College, a Master of Science in Audiology from California State University, Sacramento, and his Doctor of Audiology (Au.D.) from the University of Florida.
An Army Veteran, Dr. Kuster brings a strong sense of discipline, service, and precision to his practice.
If you experience tinnitus symptoms lasting more than 3 months, you may have chronic tinnitus. In that case, you should seek a licensed hearing specialist to discuss your hearing health.
